title: Network Traffic Signal Path Optimization
description: In a distributed telecommunications grid structured as a binary tree, each node represents a routing station with a specific bandwidth capacity (which can be positive or negative). We need to find a communication path that maximizes the total accumulated bandwidth. The path may start and end at any station in the tree, but it must follow connected parent-child links without visiting the same station twice.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 3 * 10^4].
input_format: The root node of the binary tree representing the network.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum possible path sum.

examples.explanation: The optimal path is 2 -> 1 -> 3 with a sum of 6.
The optimal path is 15 -> 20 -> 7 with a sum of 42.
The optimal path is just the single node 2.
